title: Slip upload on a cancelled payment re-opens it and auto-marks a cancelled order as paid
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/api/payments/[paymentId]/slip/route.ts:21 + packages/core/src/payments/index.ts:104 (attachSlip) and :119 (markPaid) + packages/modules/commerce/src/services/orders.ts:233 (onOrderPaid)
steps: 1) Guest places a PromptPay order on demo-shop (#1028, 650 THB). 2) Customer cancels it (cancelUnpaidOrder: order cancelled, payment cancelled, stock restocked 22->23). 3) POST a slip image to /api/payments/<paymentId>/slip (demo-shop has autoApproveSlips=true).
expected: Slip upload rejected for a payment whose status is cancelled/failed/expired/refunded (and for a cancelled order); order stays cancelled/unpaid.
actual: HTTP 200 {status:'paid'}; payment status cancelled -> paid; order #1028 status 'cancelled' + paymentStatus 'paid' + paidAt set; product soldCount 412->413 while stock stays restocked at 23; customer ordersCount/totalSpent incremented. Without auto-approve the cancelled payment is moved to pending_verification and appears in the admin queue, where verifyPayment accepts it.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-commerce1.ts A output: 'cancel true ... ps status cancelled ... stock 23 sold 412' then 'slip upload after cancel -> 200 {"status":"paid"...}' then 'AFTER {order #1028 status cancelled, pay paid, paidAt 2026-10-16T12:39:09Z, payment paid, stock 23, sold 413}'. Code: route only rejects status==='paid' (line 21); attachSlip only short-circuits on 'paid' (core payments line 104) and unconditionally sets status 'pending_verification'; markPaid only short-circuits on 'paid' (line 119); onOrderPaid only checks paymentStatus==='paid' (orders.ts:233), never order.status==='cancelled'.
suggestedFix: In attachSlip/markPaid accept only pending|pending_verification (markPaid: also failed/expired only when called from admin verify), use SELECT ... FOR UPDATE + conditional UPDATE ... WHERE status IN (...) RETURNING; route should return 409 for non-open payments. onOrderPaid should refuse (or flag for refund) when order.status is cancelled/refunded.

title: Re-uploading a slip after a full refund flips the refunded payment back to 'paid' and re-runs the paid handler
where: packages/core/src/payments/index.ts:104-111 (attachSlip) and :116-129 (markPaid); apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/api/payments/[paymentId]/slip/route.ts:21
steps: 1) Guest order #1029 on demo-shop, upload slip (auto-approved -> paid). 2) Admin refunds the full amount (refundOrderPayment -> payment 'refunded', order status/paymentStatus 'refunded'). 3) POST another slip to /api/payments/<same id>/slip.
expected: Refunded payments are terminal; slip upload returns an error and nothing changes.
actual: HTTP 200 {status:'paid'}; payment status refunded -> paid while refundedAmount stays 65000; order.paymentStatus refunded -> paid (status stays 'refunded'); paidAt overwritten; onOrderPaid runs a second time: product soldCount 414 -> 415 and customer ordersCount/totalSpent are added again. The admin now sees a 'paid' order whose money was already returned.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-commerce1.ts B output: 'refund {ok:true, paymentStatus:refunded} ... sold 414' then 'slip 2 after refund -> 200 {"status":"paid"}' then 'AFTER {#1029 status refunded, pay paid, payment status paid refunded 65000, sold 415}'. Same root cause as COR-01 (attachSlip/markPaid only guard status==='paid').
suggestedFix: Whitelist the source states in attachSlip (pending|pending_verification|failed?) and markPaid (pending|pending_verification|failed|expired), do it with a conditional UPDATE under row lock, and make the route answer 409 for refunded/partially_refunded/cancelled payments.

title: Per-customer coupon limit is never enforced for guest checkout (same phone can reuse WELCOME10 indefinitely)
where: packages/modules/commerce/src/services/cart.ts:256-257 (countCouponUsesByCustomer returns null without customerId) + cart.ts:87 (limit skipped when customerUses==null) + orders.ts:118 (re-validation uses input.customer?.id, guest customer is upserted only later at orders.ts:131)
steps: Guest (not signed in) on demo-shop: add an item, apply WELCOME10 (perCustomerLimit=1), check out with phone P. Repeat with the same phone P.
expected: Second order rejects WELCOME10 ('คุณใช้โค้ดนี้ครบจำนวนแล้ว'), because the guest is resolved to the same customer by phone.
actual: Both orders #1030 and #1031 got WELCOME10 with discount 59 THB each and are linked to the SAME customer id 01a144b9-b24e-...; discounts.used_count 6->8 although per_customer_limit=1.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-commerce1.ts C output: 'applyCoupon WELCOME10 ok amount=5900' twice; order1 {#1030 coupon WELCOME10 customerId 01a144b9-b24e-74af-a19e-6ae8e8f1a2c0 discount 5900}; order2 {#1031 coupon WELCOME10 same customerId discount 5900}; 'WELCOME10 [{used:8, per:1}]'.
suggestedFix: In createOrderFromCart resolve the guest customer (by normalized phone/email) BEFORE re-validating the coupon and pass that id to countCouponUsesByCustomer; also count by orders.phone/email for guests. Consider requiring sign-in for codes with perCustomerLimit.

title: Duplicate cart lines from parallel add-to-cart bypass the per-line stock check and oversell (stock 2 -> -4)
where: packages/db/src/schema/commerce.ts:148 (cart_items has no unique (cart_id, product_id, variant_id)); packages/modules/commerce/src/services/cart.ts:194-214 (select-then-insert merge); packages/modules/commerce/src/services/orders.ts:102-111 (stock validated per line, not per product/variant total)
steps: Create product with stock 2 (trackInventory). With one cart cookie fire 3 parallel POST /api/cart {productId, quantity:2} on demo-shop, then check out the cart.
expected: One merged line capped at 2; checkout of 6 units is rejected ('เหลือเพียง 2 ชิ้น'); stock never negative.
actual: Three separate cart_items rows with quantity 2 each; checkout succeeds as order #1036 and product stock goes 2 -> -4.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-commerce2.ts F output: 'cart lines for stock-2 product: [{q:2},{q:2},{q:2}]' and 'checkout ok #1036 stock 2 -> -4'.
suggestedFix: Add a unique index on cart_items(cart_id, product_id, coalesce(variant_id, '00000000-...')) (or NULLS NOT DISTINCT) and use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE; in createOrderFromCart aggregate required quantity per product/variant before comparing with locked stock; add a CHECK (stock >= 0) or a guarded UPDATE ... WHERE stock >= qty.

title: Double-submitting checkout creates two orders from one cart and decrements stock twice
where: packages/modules/commerce/src/services/orders.ts:78 (findActiveCart without FOR UPDATE), :204 (markCartConverted is unconditional; cart items are never cleared)
steps: Cart with 2x pillow (stock 19). Run createOrderFromCart twice in parallel with the same cart token (what a double-click / network retry of placeOrderAction does).
expected: Exactly one order; the second call fails with 'ตะกร้าว่าง' because the cart was already converted.
actual: Two orders #1034 and #1035 (both pending with their own PromptPay payments) and stock 19 -> 15.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-commerce2.ts E output: "=== E double-submit same cart [ 'ok #1034', 'ok #1035' ] pillow stock 19 -> 15".
suggestedFix: Lock the cart row (select ... for update) at the start of createOrderFromCart and re-check status='active', or convert with UPDATE carts SET status='converted' WHERE id=? AND status='active' RETURNING and abort when 0 rows; also disable the submit button while pending.

title: Coupon maxUses is not enforced under parallel checkouts (maxUses=1 used twice)
where: packages/modules/commerce/src/services/cart.ts:86 (check on an unlocked read) + packages/modules/commerce/src/services/orders.ts:116-121 and :200-202 (unconditional usedCount+1)
steps: Create percent coupon with maxUses=1 on demo-shop. Two carts with different products apply it and check out in parallel.
expected: One order gets the discount, the other is rejected/charged full price; used_count <= max_uses.
actual: Both orders #1032 (-44.50) and #1033 (-29.50) got the discount; discounts.used_count=2 with max_uses=1.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-commerce2.ts D output: "=== D maxUses race QACORYHCV0 [ 'ok #1033', 'ok #1032' ] discount row {used:2,max:1} orders with code [{#1032 discount 4450},{#1033 discount 2950}]".
suggestedFix: Lock the discount row (select ... for update) when re-validating in createOrderFromCart, or bump with UPDATE discounts SET used_count=used_count+1 WHERE id=? AND (max_uses IS NULL OR used_count < max_uses) RETURNING and fail checkout when no row is returned.

title: Paying a stale table-bill QR marks every order of the session paid even when later rounds were not covered
where: packages/modules/restaurant/src/services/orders.ts:185-193 (onRestaurantOrderPaid, kind=session, ignores payment.amount) + services/tables.ts:8 (bill_requested still accepts new orders) + tables.ts:162-177 (old pending QR stays on the session)
steps: demo-restaurant: open a session on a new table, order round 1 (R-1013, 160 THB), guest taps 'pay by PromptPay' (requestBill -> QR payment 160 THB), guests order round 2 (R-1014, 160 THB; allowed because bill_requested counts as open), then a slip is uploaded for the original QR payment (auto-approve on), or staff approves it in the generic /payments queue.
expected: Only the orders covered by the paid amount are paid; session stays due 160 THB (or the stale QR is voided when a new order is added / the handler compares payment.amount with the due total).
actual: Payment 160 THB paid -> session status 'paid', both R-1013 and R-1014 paymentStatus 'paid', sessionSummary total 320 THB, paidTotal 320 THB, dueTotal 0. settleSession would then close the table without collecting the missing 160 THB.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-rest1.ts output: 'before slip: session bill_requested total 32000 due 32000 payment.amount 16000' -> 'slip upload -> 200 {status:paid}' -> 'after slip: session paid total 32000 paidTotal 32000 due 0 orders [[R-1013,16000,paid],[R-1014,16000,paid]] payment {amount:16000,status:paid}'. Only settleSession(mode approve) checks amount (admin/orders.ts:325); the storefront slip route and /payments approvePaymentAction do not.
suggestedFix: In onRestaurantOrderPaid(kind=session) only mark orders placed before the payment was created (or until the paid amount is covered) and keep the session open when payment.amount < due; void/expire the pending session QR when a new order is added to a bill_requested session (or block ordering after bill request).

title: Cancelling a pending booking leaves its deposit payment open; paying it afterwards marks the cancelled booking deposit_paid
where: packages/modules/booking/src/services/bookings.ts:243-262 (cancelBooking never voids payments) + :219-233 (onBookingPaid ignores status cancelled/no_show)
steps: demo-salon: guest books aroma-90 (deposit 300 THB, PromptPay) -> BK-1017 pending + payment pending. Customer cancels via cancelBooking(by customer). Then a slip is uploaded to the deposit payment (storefront slip route; demo-salon auto-approves).
expected: Cancel voids pending/pending_verification deposit payments; a late payment is rejected or flagged for refund; booking stays cancelled/unpaid.
actual: After cancel the payment is still 'pending'; the slip upload returns 200 status 'paid' and BK-1017 becomes status 'cancelled' + paymentStatus 'deposit_paid' (money taken for a released slot, no refund trail).
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-book1.ts A output: 'A cancel true {bookings:[[BK-1017,cancelled,unpaid]], payments:[[pending,30000]]}' -> 'A slip -> 200 {status:paid}' -> 'A after {bookings:[[BK-1017,cancelled,deposit_paid]], payments:[[paid,30000]]}'.
suggestedFix: In cancelBooking set payments (refType booking, refId id, status pending|pending_verification) to cancelled; in onBookingPaid skip/flag when b.status is cancelled/no_show (and emit a refund-needed event); combine with the core attachSlip/markPaid status whitelist (COR-01).

title: Rescheduling an unpaid booking keeps the old deposit payment (refId = old booking); paying it confirms nothing on the new booking
where: packages/modules/booking/src/services/bookings.ts:157-166 and :205 (rescheduleOf copies answers.paymentId, skips payment creation) + :220 (onBookingPaid looks up payment.refId = old booking)
steps: demo-salon: book aroma-90 (deposit 300 THB) -> BK-1018 pending with PromptPay QR. Customer reschedules (rescheduleBooking by customer) -> BK-1019. Customer pays the QR / uploads the slip they already have for the original payment.
expected: Payment is re-pointed to the new booking (or a new payment issued and the old one cancelled); BK-1019 becomes confirmed + deposit_paid.
actual: BK-1018 (cancelled) becomes deposit_paid, BK-1019 stays 'pending' + 'unpaid'; the new booking page finds no payment for its id and asks the customer to pay the deposit again (renewPaymentAction).
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-book1.ts B output: 'B booked BK-1018 -> rescheduled BK-1019 new answers.paymentId == old payment: true result.payment null', 'B slip on original QR -> 200 {status:paid}', 'B after {bookings:[[BK-1018,cancelled,deposit_paid],[BK-1019,pending,unpaid]], payments:[[paid,30000]]}'.
suggestedFix: On reschedule of an unpaid booking update the open payment's ref_id to the new booking (or cancel it and call createBookingPayment for the new booking); when the old booking was deposit_paid keep that but also move the payment reference so refunds target the live booking.

title: Reservation capacity check is not concurrency-safe: 3 parallel bookings accepted for a zone with 1 table
where: packages/modules/restaurant/src/services/reservations.ts:38-53 (checkAvailability counts without any lock) + :88-89 and :101 (insert after the check)
steps: demo-restaurant: create a zone with exactly one active table, then submit 3 reservations for the same zone/time in parallel (e.g. several guests hitting 'จองโต๊ะ' at once, or a double-submit).
expected: Only one reservation is accepted; the others get 'โซน...เต็มในช่วงเวลานี้'.
actual: All three were created (RS-1015, RS-1016, RS-1017); checkAvailability afterwards reports capacity 1, booked 3.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-rest2.ts output: "parallel reservations in 1-table zone QA-COR-Q7AV [ 'ok RS-1015', 'ok RS-1016', 'ok RS-1017' ] availability after {available:false,capacity:1,booked:3,remaining:0}".
suggestedFix: Serialise per tenant/zone before the check (pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(tenant||zone)) or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the zone's dining_tables rows), then re-check and insert in the same transaction.

title: saveVisit recomputes billing on completed (already paid) clinic visits; the lock exists only in the client form
where: packages/modules/booking/src/admin/clinic.ts:484 (only status 'cancelled' rejected) + :497-502 (subtotal/discount/total overwritten); apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/clinic/visits/[id]/visit-form.tsx:78 (billingLocked is UI-only); saveVisitAction requires only role 'staff' (apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/clinic/actions.ts:156)
steps: Complete a visit with cash (payment row of v.total is created and marked paid). Call saveVisitAction(slug, id, input) again (server actions are plain POST endpoints) with different procedures/discount.
expected: Server rejects billing changes for completed visits (status completed / paymentStatus paid).
actual: Code path accepts it: clinic_visits.total is recomputed while the invoice payment keeps the old amount; visitKpis revenue (sum of clinic_visits.total where paid, clinic.ts:553) changes retroactively.
evidence: Code: saveVisit `if (cur.status === "cancelled") return fail(...)` is the only state guard (clinic.ts:484) before `.set({ subtotal: totals.subtotal, discount: ..., total: totals.total })` (clinic.ts:500-502); completeVisit stores the payment with amount v.total at completion time (clinic.ts:523).
suggestedFix: In saveVisit, when cur.status === 'completed' (or paymentStatus paid/waived) ignore procedures/prescriptions/discount (or fail) and only accept clinical notes/photos.

title: Patient age and birth-date max use server/UTC calendar, wrong between 00:00 and 07:00 Bangkok
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/clinic/form-values.ts:111-116 (ageFrom uses getFullYear/getMonth/getDate in the server TZ, called from server pages patients/page.tsx:93 and patients/[id]/page.tsx:44); apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/clinic/patients/patient-form.tsx:45 (max={new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)} = UTC date)

title: Outbox re-claims events that another worker is still processing when created_at is older than 10 min -> duplicate notifications
where: packages/integrations/src/outbox.ts:26-34 (stale-processing reclaim keyed on created_at instead of a claim timestamp)
steps: Insert 40 no-op events with created_at = now()-1h (any backlog, retried event or delayed booking.reminder looks like this). Run two processOutbox() drainers 400 ms apart (cron route /api/internal/outbox + tooling/worker.ts, or two overlapping cron invocations).
expected: Each event is handled once (sum of claims = 40, attempts = 1 each).
actual: Worker B re-claimed 39 events still 'processing' in worker A: 40 events ended with attempts sum 79, i.e. 39 events ran their handler twice. For real events that means duplicate SMS/LINE/email (order paid, booking reminder...).
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-outbox-race.ts output: 'worker A {claimed:52,...} worker B {claimed:39,...} | 40 events -> total claimed 91 | rows [{status:done,n:40,attempts:79}]'. Claim SQL: `where status in ('pending','processing') ... and (status = 'pending' or processed_at is null and created_at < now() - interval '10 minutes')`.
suggestedFix: Store a claimed_at/locked_until column set at claim time and reclaim only `status='processing' and claimed_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'`; alternatively keep the row locked (process inside the claiming transaction) or use a lease token checked on completion.

title: Booking reminders are still sent for cancelled / rescheduled bookings
where: packages/integrations/src/events/handlers.ts:118-126 (reminders scheduled as standalone outbox rows) + :130-137 (booking.reminder handler never re-reads the booking); packages/modules/booking/src/services/bookings.ts:243-262 and :273-313 (cancel/reschedule do not cancel scheduled reminders)
steps: Booking confirmed -> booking.confirmed handler schedules 24h/2h reminder events. Customer cancels or reschedules. When the reminder becomes due the worker runs booking.reminder.
expected: No reminder for a cancelled booking; a rescheduled booking only gets reminders for its new time.
actual: DB currently holds pending reminder events for cancelled bookings (BK-1011, BK-1002, BK-1013, BK-1004 in demo tenants). Running the handler for BK-1011 (status cancelled) wrote an SMS notification 'เตือนนัด  พรุ่งนี้' to 0891234567 for 18 ต.ค. 10:30.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-reminder-peek.ts lists pending booking.reminder rows joined to bookings with status 'cancelled'; tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-reminder-run.ts (rolled back): 'reminder event ... for BK-1011 booking status cancelled' -> '[sms:skipped] to=0891234567 "สบาย สบาย: สบาย สบาย — 18 ต.ค. 2569 10:30 หากต้องการเลื่อน..."' and notification row {channel:sms,status:skipped,title:'เตือนนัด  พรุ่งนี้'}.
suggestedFix: In booking.reminder load the booking by payload.bookingId (+tenant) and return early unless status in (pending, confirmed) and startsAt equals payload.startsAt; or delete pending reminder events on cancel/reschedule.

title: order.paid / order.created events carry no accessKey or contact data: guest 'ดูคำสั่งซื้อ' link opens 'ไม่พบคำสั่งซื้อ', owner sees 'ลูกค้า -'

The action bar only renders 'จัดส่ง' for confirmed|processing (order-actions.tsx:66).

title: Guests scanning the same table QR at the same time open several parallel sessions for one table (split bills, orders hidden from the table view)

title: OTP 5-attempt limit is bypassed by parallel verify requests (28 guesses checked against one code)
where: packages/core/src/customer/index.ts:82-95 (verifyOtp reads attempts without FOR UPDATE, then writes attempts = latest.attempts + 1 – lost update); requestOtp (:55-67) has no per-target rate limit
steps: requestOtp for a phone on demo-shop, then send 40 verifyOtp calls with wrong codes in parallel (40 concurrent POSTs of the login form).
expected: At most 5 codes are compared; the rest get 'too_many'; attempts ends at 5.
actual: 28 of 40 parallel guesses were evaluated ('invalid'), only 12 got 'too_many', and the stored attempts counter is 5 (23 increments lost). With unlimited OTP re-requests this multiplies brute-force throughput against customer accounts.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-otp.ts output: '40 parallel wrong guesses (limit 5) -> results {"invalid":28,"too_many":12} stored attempts 5'.
suggestedFix: Atomically consume an attempt: UPDATE customer_otps SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = ? AND attempts < 5 RETURNING attempts (reject when no row), or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE; add rate limiting per target/IP on requestOtp and verify.

suggestedFix: Do not write stock in saveProduct unless the field changed: send the originally loaded stock and apply stock = stock + (new - original) with an 'adjust' inventory movement, or use optimistic locking on updated_at.

title: Nothing ever expires unpaid payments: abandoned PromptPay orders keep stock reserved and unpaid deposit bookings keep their slot forever
where: packages/core/src/payments/index.ts:62 (expiresAt stored) — no code path sets payments.status='expired' or cancels the order/booking (grep: only the read-side mapping in api/payments/[paymentId]/route.ts:9 and restaurant dto.ts:60); no handler/cron in packages/integrations or tooling/worker.ts
steps: Place a PromptPay order (30-min QR) or book a deposit service and never pay; check the rows after the QR expiry.
expected: After expiresAt (+grace) the payment becomes 'expired' and the order/booking/reservation is auto-cancelled, releasing stock / the staff slot / the table (or at least the admin is told).
actual: Orders #1030/#1031 on demo-shop: QR expired 13:09:43/45 UTC, still order 'pending' + payment 'pending', 1 unit each still deducted from stock. demo-salon BK-1001: deposit QR expired 2026-10-15 15:57 UTC (21 h earlier), booking still 'pending' and still blocks the 17 Oct 07:00 slot (pending is not a released status); BK-1015/BK-1016 likewise.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/correctness-expiry2.ts output at 2026-10-16T13:10:03Z: orders holding stock with an expired, never-paid QR: [#1030 pending/unpaid pay pending expires 13:09:43 units 1, #1031 ... 13:09:45 units 1]; bookings holding a slot with an expired deposit QR: [BK-1015, BK-1001 (expires_at 2026-10-15 15:57:16), BK-1016]. grep -rn '"expired"' over packages/apps/tooling finds no writer of payments.status='expired'.
suggestedFix: Add an outbox/cron job (e.g. emit a delayed 'payment.expire_check' event at createPayment with delaySeconds = expiresMinutes*60) that, if still pending, marks the payment expired and runs a module 'onFailed/expired' handler (commerce: cancelUnpaidOrder-like restock; booking: cancel pending booking; restaurant: cancel pending reservation).

title: Cancelling a reservation leaves its deposit payment payable; a late slip is auto-approved with no refund trail
where: packages/modules/restaurant/src/services/reservations.ts:158-165 (cancelReservation never touches the pending deposit payment) + :149-152 (onReservationPaid silently returns for non-pending reservations); generic root cause in core attachSlip/markPaid (COR-01)
steps: Reservation with deposit (status pending, payment pending) -> staff/customer cancels -> customer uploads the slip for the deposit QR (storefront /api/payments/<id>/slip, auto-approve on demo tenants) or staff approves it in /payments.
expected: Cancel voids the open deposit payment; a later payment attempt is refused or flagged for refund.
actual: Payment goes pending -> paid while the reservation stays 'cancelled'; onReservationPaid returns early, nothing records that the shop now owes a refund.
evidence: Code: cancelReservation only runs `update(reservations).set({ status: 'cancelled' })` and emits reservation.cancelled (reservations.ts:163-164); onReservationPaid: `if (r.status !== "pending") return;` (reservations.ts:151); slip route accepts any non-'paid' payment (slip/route.ts:21) as proven in COR-01/COR-08.
suggestedFix: Cancel pending/pending_verification payments in cancelReservation; in onReservationPaid emit a 'refund_needed' event / mark the reservation for refund when it is no longer pending.
